explanation: Edmond Halley predicted that the comet would return in 1758. He died in 1742, and when it reappeared on time, it was named after him.

claims.text: Halley's Comet returns to the inner Solar System about every 76 years; its period ranges from about 74 to 79 years.
Halley's Comet's period is nowhere near 36, 56 or 96 years.
Edmond Halley predicted that the comet would return in 1758.
The comet was named after Halley once it returned as he had predicted.
